> According to Claude:
> 
> TLDR: Anthropic recently locked down Claude Code authentication tokens so they can't be used with third-party tools like OpenCode. You'll need a separate API key from console.anthropic.com.
> 
> TOC
> 
> What's happening Why the change Your options
> 
> What's Happening Anthropic has recently tightened the authentication for Claude Code. The OAuth token you get when you run claude and authenticate is now scoped exclusively to the official Claude Code CLI. Previously, this token worked as a general API credential — now it doesn't. This is a deliberate change, not a bug. Why the Change Strong opinion: This is Anthropic protecting their usage-based pricing model. Claude Code has different (more generous) rate limits and possibly different billing arrangements than raw API access. By locking the credential, they're preventing:
> 
> Third-party tools piggybacking on Claude Code's auth Potential abuse of the authentication flow Usage that bypasses their standard API billing
> 
> Fair enough from a business perspective, but it does break workflows people had set up.

> [@ShidaYuumi](https://github.com/ShidaYuumi) Does this work? `ctrl+x b` or `ctrl+p show sidebar` Although this allows the sidebar to be displayed, it introduces a new issue. Previously in version 1.1.6, when the window was relatively small, the MCP and LSP would appear in the bottom-left corner of the window. They would only shift to the right side when the window was enlarged to a certain extent. Using 'show sidebar' causes them to be displayed on the right side at all times, which leads to display issues in small windows. However, there are no problems when the window is large.
